test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 29 July, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If the average of 16, 28, 30, x, and 34 is 30, then the value of x is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the net deviation method by comparing each number with the average (30).

Deviations: (16 − 30) = −14, (28 − 30) = −2, (30 − 30) = 0, (34 − 30) = +4.

Sum of known deviations = −14 − 2 + 0 + 4 = −12.

To maintain an average of 30, the total net deviation must be 0.

Deviation of x = +12 ⇒ x = 30 + 12 = 42.

**∴ The correct answer is 42.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Numbers = 16, 28, 30, x, 34

Total count (n) = 5

Average = 30

**Formula Used:**

Average = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e58312bda98788986f34b818a1ef9fc75b28e988b32fd5343a169546b85fec1.png] 

⇒ 30 = (16 + 28 + 30 + x + 34) ÷ 5

⇒ 30 × 5 = 108 + x

⇒ 150 = 108 + x

⇒ x = 150 − 108

⇒ x = 42

**∴ The correct answer is 42.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Arithmetic Mean

It is the sum of all values divided by the total number of values. Formula: Mean = Σxᵢ ÷ n.

Property of Deviations

The sum of the deviations of a set of observations from their arithmetic mean is always zero.

Change in Average

If each observation is increased or decreased by a constant 'k', the new average also increases or decreases by 'k'.</p
